text: 加拿大蒙特利尔银行资本市场首席经济学家道格拉斯·波特在周末发布的报告中表示，加拿大的财政政策与货币政策可能正在朝着相反的方向发力。波特表示，加拿大政府公布的年度预算计划内容比预期更加充实，带来了力度可观的财政刺激。受此影响，该行已将加拿大2027年GDP增长预期从1.8%上调至2%。与此同时，加拿大央行为应对上调后的通胀预期而加息，未来还可能进一步加息。波特表示：“如果这还不算政策方向相互矛盾，那就很难想象什么情况才算政策冲突。”此外，他指出，就业数据疲软、油价回落以及科技股抛售，可能促使加拿大央行决策者重新评估是否有必要在12月再次加息。
text_en: Douglas Porter, chief economist at BMO Capital Markets, said in a report released over the weekend that Canada's fiscal and monetary policies may be pulling in opposite directions. Porter said the annual budget plan unveiled by the Canadian government was more substantial than expected, delivering considerable fiscal stimulus. As a result, the bank has raised its 2027 GDP growth forecast for Canada from 1.8% to 2%. At the same time, the Bank of Canada is raising interest rates in response to upgraded inflation expectations and may raise them further in the future. Porter said: "If that is not contradictory policy direction, it is hard to imagine what is." He also noted that weak employment data, falling oil prices and the tech stock selloff may prompt Bank of Canada policymakers to reassess whether another rate hike in December is necessary.
